text.arabic_uthmani: وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ ۖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّۢ وَلَا نَصِيرٍۢ

baseline.text: Siz ne yeryüzünde ne de gökte Allah'ı etkisiz bırakabilirsiniz. Allah'tan başka hiçbir koruyucunuz ve yardımcınız yoktur.

findings.text: Yeryüzü ile göğün birlikte anılması, kaçış için dışarıda bir bölge bırakmaz; “etkisiz bırakamama” burada her yerde takipten kurtulamamaktır.
Allah'tan başka yakın görünen bağlar, gerçek koruma ve üstün getiren yardım eşiğine hiçbir zaman ulaşamaz.

activation_trace.role: Falling beyond a pursuer's reach supplies the attempted escape, and the negation cancels that function.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the merism's terrestrial half.
What rises and overshadows supplies the upper realm that completes the spatial totality.

changed_reading.after: A denial that they can outpace divine pursuit anywhere in the lower or upper domain.
changed_reading.before: A generic denial that the addressees can overpower.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ
baseline_models.mechanism: مُعْجِزِينَ casts evasion as gaining an unreachable lead, while earth below and sky above form an exhaustive vertical merism; no location supplies a successful head start or exit.

activation_trace.role: Otherness or substitution supplies the excluded alternative position beside God.
The worshipped one supplies the exclusive relational center against which alternatives are denied.
Taking charge and standing over an affair supplies durable guardianship as the first denied support mode.
Aid that makes one prevail against an opponent supplies active rescue as the second denied support mode.

changed_reading.after: No substitute can either carry the addressee's affairs continuously or intervene effectively when opposition arrives.
changed_reading.before: There is no ally or helper besides God.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّۢ وَلَا نَصِيرٍۢ
baseline_models.mechanism: The construction removes every alternative to God, then distinguishes sustained charge or protective alignment from intervention that gives aid against opposition; neither support channel exists independently beside God.

activation_trace.role: Getting away from a pursuer supplies the earlier attempted maneuver that 29:22 categorically denies.
Outrunning or eluding pursuit supplies the focus anchor that answers the earlier question.

changed_reading.after: The verse answers the wrongdoer's imagined race: no early lead, delay, or distance can put accountability behind them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier question whether wrongdoers can precede or escape God supplies the race that مُعْجِزِينَ later closes: accountability cannot be defeated by gaining time, distance, or a lead.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two images of escaping a pursuer; I read the later negation as answering the earlier question. A live alternative is simple precedence in 29:4, but its escape branch makes the race linkage unusually tight.
structural_cues: 29:4 poses the outstripping question before 29:22 gives the categorical negation.
The two branch images share a pursuit-and-evasion frame rather than generic power language.

activation_trace.role: Release by separation supplies a concrete rescue from the threatened fire.
The divine name identifies the rescuer and fixes the rescue's source.
A direct request for aid against opponents makes the focus noun's active assistance operational.
Aid and prevailing assistance supply the focus category whose independent alternatives are denied.

changed_reading.after: Effective help is real as divine extraction and support; what is impossible is an independent rescue channel outside God.
changed_reading.before: No helper is available besides God.

context_deltas.mechanism: Actual divine extraction from fire and the direct petition for victory show that the focus does not announce a help-less universe; it denies autonomous help outside God and redirects the request to its effective source.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine rescue and a direct divine petition; I infer that the focus negates independent sources, not the occurrence of rescue. A narrower eschatological-only reading remains possible, but the surrounding rescues broaden the functional field.
structural_cues: 29:24 explicitly attributes Abraham's rescue to God.
29:30 addresses the request for نصر to the Lord rather than to an alternative patron.

activation_trace.role: The alternative beside God locates the coalition in the very substitute position denied by the focus.
Affection supplies the bond that temporarily holds the substitute network together.
A connection standing between parties supplies the network's social linkage.
Expulsion under anger reverses the earlier affection into an anti-protective relation.
The final absence of supporters states the coalition's failure to become effective aid.
Love, alliance, and mutual aid supply the focus relation that the later social reversal tests.

changed_reading.after: Alternative patronage can look socially cohesive for a time, yet its own bonds reverse direction and leave every member unsupported.
changed_reading.before: No protective ally or helper exists besides God.

context_deltas.mechanism: Substitute worship is maintained as affection connecting a group in worldly life, but the same network reverses into mutual repudiation, expulsion, and the absence of supporters; the focus denial thus exposes a patronage coalition whose bonds invert under judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a worldly bond, its reciprocal reversal, and failed support; I treat these as stages of one patronage network. The idols are the overt objects, while the verse's بَيْنِكُمْ keeps the human coalition materially live.
structural_cues: 29:25 places worldly affection and final mutual cursing in one explicit temporal sequence.
The repeated بَعْضُكُم بِبَعْضٍ makes the reversal reciprocal before the verse ends with no supporters.

activation_trace.role: Otherness supplies the alternative placement outside God.
Assuming charge over an affair supplies the protective function assigned to the chosen patrons.
The web-spinning creature supplies an active maker whose construction nevertheless cannot bear protective weight.
Dwelling and shelter give patronage a concrete architectural function.
Loss of strength supplies the structural failure of the supposed shelter.
Durable charge over one's affairs is the focus function that the weak-house image reconfigures.

changed_reading.after: They may construct a substitute protection system, but it is a shelter whose internal material cannot carry the protective function assigned to it.
changed_reading.before: The addressees simply lack an alternative protector.

context_deltas.mechanism: Taking protectors is rendered as constructing a dwelling: the spider genuinely builds and occupies a house, yet the structure is the weakest shelter. Substitute patronage is therefore not merely missing but materially misbuilt for the load of protection placed on it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet itself supplies the patron-house simile; I infer that shelter is the functional bridge from house to protective charge. A broader reading as fragile religious or social organization remains compatible rather than excluded.
structural_cues: 29:41 explicitly equates taking awliya besides God with a spider taking a house.
The simile preserves successful construction but denies protective adequacy, sharpening the kind of failure involved.

activation_trace.role: Bringing creation into existence supplies authorship of both spatial domains.
The overhanging heavens supply the upper half of the authored jurisdiction.
The lower earth supplies the authored jurisdiction's terrestrial half.
Standing over an affair until sufficiency is achieved supplies God's complete evidentiary adequacy.
Presence with observation supplies witness across the disputed relation.
Disclosure to the knower removes the possibility of an unseen refuge.
Attempted evasion remains the focus action now blocked by authored and observed jurisdiction.

changed_reading.after: Earth and sky are an authored and fully witnessed jurisdiction, so escape cannot exploit either an unowned zone or an observational blind spot.
changed_reading.before: Earth and sky exhaust the places where escape might be attempted.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation of the heavens and earth, followed by God's sufficiency as witness and knowledge of everything within them, turns the focus merism from empty geography into authored, observed jurisdiction. There is no unowned or unseen corner from which to outstrip accountability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies authorship, witnessing, and knowledge over the same merism; I infer that these jointly eliminate unowned and unseen refuge. The focus may stress raw power more than surveillance, but the witness sequence adds a real epistemic layer.
structural_cues: 29:44 coordinates heavens and earth as a single created pair.
29:52 repeats the same pair as the full field of divine knowledge while naming God sufficient witness.

activation_trace.role: Causing something to descend and reach its destination supplies the sky-to-ground delivery vector.
The overhanging sky supplies a source direction for the descending affliction.
The earth's sinking supplies a downward mode of seizure.
The lower realm becomes an instrument that engulfs rather than a refuge.
Encompassment by domination and destruction supplies enclosure already in force.
A covering that generalizes over its objects supplies the enclosing event's contact.
The upper direction supplies one face of the closing vertical field.
The underside beneath the feet supplies the opposing face, leaving no vertical gap.

changed_reading.after: The very domains sought as refuge can deliver, engulf, and close around the fugitive from above and below.
changed_reading.before: Neither earth nor sky offers a place of escape.

context_deltas.mechanism: Punishment descends from the sky, the earth opens downward, and the final scene is already encompassing before it covers from above and beneath the feet. The focus coordinates become active delivery surfaces of reckoning rather than neutral places in which one might hide.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent, sinking, prior encompassment, and two-sided vertical cover; I read these episodes as unpacking the focus merism into active vectors. They can also stand as separate judgment scenes, but their repeated geometry preserves the linkage.
structural_cues: 29:34 makes the sky a source of descent, while 29:40 makes the earth a mode of engulfment.
29:54 says the enclosure already surrounds; 29:55 then renders it as cover from above and beneath the feet.

activation_trace.role: The terrestrial domain supplies the same focus arena, now marked as God's own earth.
Expanse opposed to constriction supplies genuine room for relocation within the domain.
Submissive worship supplies the purpose that distinguishes faithful movement from evasive flight.
Escape from pursuit supplies the prohibited movement type, contrasted with permitted relocation.

changed_reading.after: There is abundant room to move faithfully within God's earth, but no route turns relocation into exit from His claim.
changed_reading.before: No escape on earth can sound like total spatial confinement.

context_deltas.mechanism: God's earth is explicitly spacious and paired with the command to worship Him, so the focus denial is not spatial claustrophobia or a ban on relocation. Horizontal movement remains ample, but no movement crosses out of divine allegiance and jurisdiction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies breadth within God's earth and an exclusive worship imperative; I infer that relocation can serve obedience without becoming metaphysical evasion. The verse may specifically license migration, which strengthens rather than exhausts this distinction.
structural_cues: 29:56 joins possessive أَرْضِى, spatial breadth, and exclusive worship in one compact command.
The broad earth follows the focus denial without retracting it, forcing a distinction between mobility and escape.

activation_trace.role: The repeated alternative position beside God marks the proposed providers as substitutes.
Ownership with power of disposal supplies the capacity explicitly denied to the substitutes.
An apportioned gift supplies the concrete good the substitutes cannot provide and seekers must request from God.
Carrying a visible load supplies the creature's inability to transport its own provision.
Sustaining food supplies the recurring support that God provides to dependent creatures.
The divine name fixes the source of the provision that dependents cannot carry for themselves.
Standing over another's affairs supplies the durable support function broadened into maintenance.
Effective aid supplies the help category extended from conflict into material dependence.

changed_reading.after: Their denied substitute function also reaches the quiet infrastructure of survival: no alternative owns or reliably carries one's provision.
changed_reading.before: Wali and nasir concern protection or victory in moments of conflict.

context_deltas.mechanism: The substitutes worshipped beside God do not own or dispose of provision, while creatures unable to carry their own allotment are fed by God. The denied wali and nasir therefore include ordinary maintenance and supply, not only emergency intervention or combat aid.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed substitute ownership and divine maintenance of non-carrying creatures; I map provision onto the practical work of guardianship and aid. A narrower legal or martial sense of wali/nasir remains live, so this broadening stays medium-confidence.
structural_cues: 29:17 repeats مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ while denying the idols ownership of provision.
29:60 reverses inability to carry provision into God's ongoing act of provisioning.

remaining_uncertainties: Whether earth-sky primarily marks exhaustive extent or actively instrumental geography; the surah supports both.
Whether wali and nasir are chiefly eschatological, legal-social, or broadly practical support terms; context widens them without erasing the narrower senses.
The sky-aperture activation is packet-authorized but form-distant and must remain explicitly analogical.
strongest_changes: The earlier attempt to outstrip God turns مُعْجِزِينَ into the answer to a failed race, not merely a generic lack of power.
Concrete rescues and direct petitions show that help is exclusive to God rather than absent from the world.
Worldly affection, mutual cursing, and the spider house expose substitute patronage as both reversible social linkage and structurally inadequate shelter.
Creation, witness, descending punishment, engulfing earth, and above-below enclosure make earth and sky an authored, observed, active jurisdiction.
The spaciousness of God's earth separates legitimate relocation from impossible evasion.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah activation converted a flat spatial warning into interacting pursuit, rescue, coalition, shelter, jurisdiction, and provision mechanisms, while the split sky inventory and rain branch preserved two contained readings that a conservative synthesis would likely lose.

activation_trace.role: A narrow opening through which something enters supplies an exploratory ingress image for the focus sky.
The same packet-authorized split branch turns the contextual sky into a possible opening rather than an escape expanse.
Delivery by descent supplies the directional event that makes the aperture image functionally relevant.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the upper region is not an exit but an ingress through which reckoning can be delivered.
changed_reading.before: The sky is imagined as an open upper region into which one might flee.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's split س م م inventory rather than the ordinary س م و sky branch. It remains anchored to the exact focus sky occurrence and is sharpened by punishment descending from the sky in 29:34; downstream prose should present it only as a form-distant aperture analogy, never as the lexical sense of سَمَاء.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ at 29:22, reactivated by مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ at 29:34

activation_trace.role: Rain that relieves and makes land grow supplies an ecological image of effective help.
The sky as cloud and rain-bearing upper cover supplies the source domain of the relief.
Water delivered by pouring supplies the material means of the help.
Earth's life through rain and vegetation supplies the restorative effect.
The fertile, planted earth supplies the recipient whose revival makes rain function as aid.

changed_reading.after: The help denied to alternatives can also be pictured, without displacing the ordinary sense, as life-restoring relief moving from sky to earth.
changed_reading.before: A nasir is imagined only as an agent who intervenes against an opponent.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain because نَصِير normally evokes a personal helper, yet the focus inventory itself carries a rain-and-relief branch and 29:63 explicitly joins sky-water-earth revival with God. Downstream prose should qualify it as an ecological branch activation, not replace the ordinary agency sense of nasir with a dictionary claim about rain.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نَصِيرٍ at 29:22 within the surah's sky-water-earth revival sequence

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **No geography of elusion.** ع ج ز B002 is “escape, outstripping, and eluding pursuit,” alongside B001's inability. Earth and sky exhaust the imagined search-space, and absence of patron or helper removes relational escape. I infer that evasion requires either an outside territory or an effective ally; by denying both, the ayah reads “not causing failure” as total non-eludability rather than mere weakness.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 29:67's secure sanctuary might appear to be a local exception, but its safety is explicitly made by God amid surrounding seizure. It confirms that protection is granted within the inescapable domain, not an escape from it.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Incapacity is specifically failure to elude pursuit across the full vertical field.** Lexical evidence: `بِمُعْجِزِينَ`, root `ع ج ز`, `B002` (escape, outstripping, and eluding pursuit); `ٱلْأَرْض`, root `ء ر ض`, `B001` (lower ground opposite the sky); and `ٱلسَّمَاء`, root `س م و`, `B004` (overhead sky and cover). Structural cue: earth and sky are joined by repeated negation after `29:20-21` asserted effective capacity and reversal. Assigned role: the paired regions close horizontal and vertical escape routes; `ع ج ز B002` defines the failed maneuver. Abductive move: the packet supplies exhaustive spatial opposition and denial; I infer that the target is imagined evasion, not generic inability to perform any act. Reading change: the ayah says the addressees cannot make themselves uncatchable anywhere in the created field.

2. **Nearer alternatives never reach the threshold of protective agency.** Lexical evidence: `مِن دُونِ`, root `د و ن`, `B001` (nearness short of a limit); `وَلِىّ`, root `و ل ي`, `B004` (loyal alliance and support); and `نَصِير`, root `ن ص ر`, `B001` (aid that makes someone prevail). Structural cue: `29:17` denied alternative providers, `29:21` centralized allocation, and `29:24-26` show rescue and migration oriented to God alone. Assigned role: other alliances may be socially near, but they fall short of effective protection and prevailing aid. Abductive move: “short of the limit” does not itself identify which limit; I infer from `ولي/نصير` that it is the threshold of effective rescue. Reading change: the denial concerns operational protection, not the mere existence of associates.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - **Later correction (`29:41`, `29:56`):** The spider house gives a material model for allies that cannot protect, while the wide earth authorizes relocation for worship. Together they distinguish two claims in `29:22`: no region permits metaphysical evasion, yet earthly movement remains a valid response to failed local protection.

words.gloss_range: reinforcing predicate bāʾ in the negative construction, visibly attached to the participial predicate
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) is not a locative or instrumental preposition here. It is the reinforcing predicate particle in the negated nominal frame, governing the following participle and tightening the denial. Its visible attachment to the predicate makes the denied class sound and look bound into the negation.

words.gloss_range: Form IV active participle denying the addressees' capacity to elude, frustrate, or render the divine purpose incapable
words.prose: {{ar:مُعْجِزِينَ}} ({{tr:muʿjizīna}}) is the first panel's key denied class. As a Form IV active participle, it casts the addressees as would-be agents who might make the divine purpose fail, outrun it, or render it incapable, then denies that role. The participial form makes this a durable capacity-denial, and the earth-sky locatives spread that denial across created space. The familiar no-escape formula seen at 42:31 and 46:32 is made local here by that spatial expansion. After the prior return statement, the word blocks the imagined counter-motion: no one can turn the return back or leave it behind, and its constricted consonant texture reinforces that resistance only as a secondary cue.
words.root_gloss_range: weakness, inability, rearwardness, and causative incapacitating; local Form IV selects failed counter-agency and escape/frustration denial

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word denies more than flight; it denies the attempt to make the divine agent unable.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the surface as a Form IV active participle, and the local predicate relation licenses the counter-agency denial.

topics.headline: escape and frustration senses both matter

topics.headline: participle makes a stable denied class

words.prose: {{ar:الْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) names the first domain where escape is denied. Its definite singular form treats the earth as a known total lower realm, not a random patch of land, and its pairing with {{ar:السَّمَاءِ}} ({{tr:al-samāʾi}}) creates the lower pole of a cosmic enclosure. The ground/territory range remains concrete, while the sky contrast broadens it to the whole lower world. The same earth-domain is a repeated stage in this surah for signs, movement, creation, possession, and provision (29:20, 29:39, 29:56, 29:61, 29:63), so the no-escape domain is also a domain of divine action.

With the following for-you phrase and the later universalizing particle before the patron noun, it creates a verbless existential frame: there is no alternative support available for the addressees. The same particle shape therefore pairs the panels while the syntax shifts from denied capacity to denied possession.

topics.reason: The construction is a compressed existential possession frame with delayed denied nouns.

words.gloss_range: prepositional lām with attached second-person plural suffix, forming the for-you possession/specification frame
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}), with its attached plural suffix, personalizes the second panel. The wording does not merely say that support is absent in the abstract; it says no such support is for you. The bound suffix carries the same addressed group from the independent pronoun into the possession frame, and the denied patron and helper nouns are delayed until after that lack is assigned to them. Its compressed preposition-suffix form and nasal handoff into the exclusion phrase make the move from for-you to apart-from-God feel tightly joined.

topics.reason: The preposition governs the plural suffix and functions as the fronted predicate of the existential construction.

topics.reason: The fronted prepositional phrase precedes the denied nouns and marks the second panel's possessive frame.

topics.reason: The fused form is morphologically real; sound linkage is supportive rather than the main syntactic claim.

words.gloss_range: first min in the second panel, forming the apart-from-God exclusion phrase with the following noun
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) begins the exclusion phrase, not the later zero-instance quantifier. With the following exclusion noun it forms the compact besides-God frame, routing the aid-denial through a boundary: no support comes from any source apart from God. The compact nasal-to-stop transition makes the exclusion phrase sound like a tight unit. The identical surface later before the patron noun is re-parsed by its neighbor, so the panel uses the same small form for two different jobs.

words.gloss_range: relational exclusion noun in the besides-God phrase, carrying apartness and below/short-of hierarchy
words.prose: {{ar:دُونِ}} ({{tr:dūni}}) is the word that turns the second panel into a boundary claim. It is governed by the preceding particle and governs the divine name after it, so every later support noun is measured from outside or short of that reference point. The lowness/short-of image gives hierarchy to the exclusion, while unrelated derivative fields remain background rather than the selected local sense. The same besides-God field appears around worship, love, and false protectors in this surah (29:17, 29:25, 29:41, 29:42), while here it is narrowed to absent aid; the slowed phrase center at the divine name reinforces that boundary.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name completing the exclusion phrase and serving as the reference point against which all alternative support is denied
words.prose: {{ar:اللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) completes the besides-God phrase and becomes the second panel's hinge. The proper name fixes the reference point: after it, every possible patron or helper outside that reference is negated. Devotion and refuge associations sharpen why alternatives fail, but the proper-name form keeps the phrase specific rather than generic. Its direct liaison with the exclusion word makes the boundary audible, and the surah's repeated divine-reference framework keeps this name as the governing reference for the denial.

words.gloss_range: second min in the second panel, a negation-strengthening quantifier before the indefinite patron noun
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) has a different job from the earlier exclusion particle. Here, before the indefinite patron noun and under negation, it makes the denial zero-instance: not any patron whatsoever. After the mercy statement in 29:21, that quantification matters: no alternate patron can replace divine mercy. The repeated particle shape keeps the panel compact, while the neighboring noun distinguishes quantity from the earlier besides-God boundary, and the nasal contact with the patron noun binds the not-any force to that noun.

words.gloss_range: indefinite singular patron/protector noun under negation, denying any relational guardian, patron, or authority outside God
words.prose: {{ar:وَلِيٍّ}} ({{tr:waliyyin}}) is the first denied aid category. Its indefinite singular form after the quantifying particle denies even one patron, and its root-field of nearness, loyalty, and taking charge makes the loss relational: no close guardian or protective authority remains outside God. Its durable relational shape and geminated ending make the denied closeness feel compact rather than momentary. Its position before {{ar:نَصِيرٍ}} ({{tr:naṣīrin}}) matters because patronal nearness is denied before active rescue, and the later false-protector image in 29:41 exposes the same failed category in plural form.

words.gloss_range: singular indefinite intensive helper/rescuer noun coordinated with the denied patron and closing the ayah on active-help denial
words.prose: {{ar:نَصِيرٍ}} ({{tr:naṣīrin}}) is the ayah's closing support term. It shares the genitive indefinite frame with the patron noun, so it remains coordinated under the same denial, but its root and intensive form move from protective nearness to active rescue and effective aid. Even the help-seeking pathway is narrowed to this surface noun: no appeal would find such a helper. The final position matters: after no escape in earth or sky and no patron outside God, the ayah lands on no reliable helper, not even one whose defining trait would be support. The familiar patron-helper denial formula seen at 2:107, 9:116, and 42:31 is concentrated here, and the same no-help motif continues nearby in 29:25. Its shared indefinite cadence with the patron noun and long-vowel resonance back to the opening denied escape class make the two panels audible as a frame.
